title: News feed: fan-out on write or on read?
brief: Build the home feed of a social app: a feed shows the latest posts from everyone you follow. Posting is a write, opening your feed is a read. Each post has to reach every follower's feed somehow: either copied in when it's posted, or gathered when the feed is opened. Mark that step on the canvas: select a connection and set its Fan-out. Same app, two follower graphs.

requirements: Everyone has about 200 friends: 200 followers, follows 200
feeds are built (an edge fans out)
variants.twist: A celebrity joins and 1% of posts now come from accounts with 50k followers. The average followers per post goes to about 700. Apply with set_traffic(followers=700). Which block grows, and is fan-out on write still the right call for everyone?

requirements: Posts come from creators with about 100k followers each; a reader follows about 20 creators
feeds are built (an edge fans out)
variants.twist: Readers start following more creators: 60 each on average. Apply with set_traffic(following=60). What grows, and what would you cache harder?

hints: When someone opens their feed, where do its posts come from? When someone posts, who needs to see it?

You can do that work when a post is written (copy it into every follower's feed) or when a feed is read (gather from everyone the reader follows). Mark the connection that does it with Fan-out, then compare posts/s × followers with reads/s × following.

Friends: fan out on write into a cache that holds every user's feed (2 nodes), and store each post once in a KV store on a writes-only connection. Creators: 200 posts/s × 100k followers is 20M copies/s, so fan out on read instead, through a cache (hit 0.9) in front of the posts store.
_notes: Sim: 20k rps at 0.99 reads = 19.8k reads + 200 posts/s. api 33 replicas (1k each, rho 0.61). friends: fan-out on write = 200 x 200 = 40k cache writes + 19.8k reads on a 2-node feeds cache (100k cap, rho 0.6), posts kv on a writes-only edge: PASS, $4.53. Fan-out on read = 19.8k x 200 = 3.96M reads: 13 cache + 7 kv nodes melt (rho 10), fail. creators: fan-out on write = 200 x 100k = 20M writes/s: feeds cache rho 330, fail. Fan-out on read = 19.8k x 20 = 396k reads through 13 cache nodes (hit 0.9) and 7 kv replicas: PASS, $7.38. 20 cache + 10 kv: $9.33, over the $9 budget. No fan-out at all fails the 'feeds are built' check. Checked in frontend/src/lessons/content.test.ts.
